set.body: Topofmri real-workflow reproduction: ot_partial_sinkhorn log backend at epsilon .075, mass .75, tol 1e-10 stops at iteration 1757 of 20000 with objective_mismatch and duality gap 1.915e-6 above certificate tolerance 3.113e-8. Core termination checks only plan update and primal feasibility, so unused budget cannot reduce the failed KKT certificate. Tighter tolerance continues and decreases the gap. Retain honest nonconvergence; require the existing certificate before early termination in both scaling and log cores. Add regression and independent primal/dual evidence; preserve warm-state and nested partial GW contracts. External reproduction: /Volumes/My Passport for Mac/topofmri/assessment/rfugw-partial-stop-repro.R. Follow-up to closed bd-01M0JGQ94970ZZ5708CVK5A5HQ; consumer epic topofmri bd-01M26JR8KEWCBJYKJH5C5RKJ99.
set.title: Continue partial Sinkhorn until its certificate passes or the budget is exhausted
